chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah al-Barqi (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Abu Muhammad al-Ansari, from more than one person, from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said:
Whoever awakes and finds the coolness of our love upon his heart should praise God for the beginning of blessings.
It was said: What is the beginning of blessings? He said: A pure birth.

key_terms.بادئ النعم: The beginning/first of blessings — the foundational blessing from which all others flow
key_terms.برد حبنا: The coolness/refreshing quality of our love — an evocative metaphor for the soothing, comforting experience of genuine devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.طيب المولد: Pure birth/wholesome origin — refers to legitimate descent and a spiritually pure lineage, a prerequisite for receiving divine grace

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about the love for the Ahl al-Bayt and pure birth?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) teaches that love for the Ahl al-Bayt is a divine blessing, and whoever finds this love in his heart should give thanks to God for it. When asked to identify the foundational blessing that makes this love possible, the Imam identifies it as 'a pure birth' (طيب المولد) — meaning legitimate lineage and a spiritually wholesome origin. This hadith reflects the Shia theological belief that love for the Imams is not merely an emotional disposition but a divinely-granted gift rooted in one's spiritual purity of origin.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah al-Barqi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narratred to us from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd from Abi Muhammad al-Ansari from another person from Abi Ja`far al-Baqir (as). He said:
Whoever awakes and finds the coolness of our love upon his heart should praise Allah for the beginning of blessing.
It was said: What is the beginning of blessing? So, he said: A pure birth.
